Input image 1 is the APPROVED design master for M09 municipal patrol labor. Preserve its exact tall helmet, proportions, broad curved body shells, palette and equipment. This is a projection of the same approved machine, not a redesign.
Draw ONE full-body FRONT view ONLY, upright calm neutral stance, head and torso facing directly toward viewer, symmetric body, feet on one level, both arms lowered naturally. Portrait 1024x1536 white background, complete top of helmet fins, feet, wall and backpack with ample margin. No extra closeups, no other views, no labels, no scenery. Clean colored Japanese mecha production illustration with black ink outlines, cel shading and subtle service wear, same rendering as source.

Ivory domed patrol helmet, slate forehead band, small amber roof lamp, black inset visor and two cyan eyes, ivory angular mouth guard. TWO restrained rectangular fins behind helmet, same height/direction as master. Smooth domed slate shoulders with red stripes, ivory upper chest vents and curved slate chest band, ivory abdomen, rounded long ivory limbs, slate kneecaps and slate toes, rubber black joint gaiters. Thin red reflective marks, no franchise logos.
Inventory: EXACTLY SIX flat rectangular traffic-wall modules total. ONE unfolded long flat traffic wall is held in the robot’s ANATOMICAL LEFT hand (viewer RIGHT), vertical beside the body; ivory face, slate border, red diagonal reflective band, fold-out base feet stowed. FIVE folded narrow wall modules are carried VERTICALLY on backpack: TWO on anatomical LEFT (viewer RIGHT) and THREE on anatomical RIGHT (viewer LEFT); most are naturally occluded in this front projection, only their top edges/side rails peek behind shoulders. Do not place six on the back plus a held seventh. Empty right hand relaxed. The wall is NOT a curved body plate. Keep exact same approved head and body identity. No weapons, no infantry tactical armor, no Gundam fins, no super-deformed proportions.

Draw ONE full-body FRONT view ONLY, tall upright neutral stance, head and torso squarely facing viewer, both black fists naturally lowered, feet on same baseline. Portrait 1024x1536 white background, complete helmet, bridge packs, hands, feet with ample margin. No closeups, no vehicle inset, no diagrams, no text. Same confident black ink outline, cel-shaded painted mecha finish and restrained service wear as master.
Precisely preserve the approved adult stocky-but-tall engineering body proportions: tall normal helmet, broad truck-cab chest, visible waist, substantial full-length thighs and shins. No big-head short-body, no flattened head, no skinny fashion body. Orange firefighter helmet with thick brow and short service ear fixtures, cyan eyes, ivory humanoid face WITH a mouth line and short thick projecting chin, NOT a facemask/grille. Same rescue ORANGE + WARM IVORY, black graphite joints, dark teal windscreen, amber lamps.
Chest is the original flat-front truck cab, paired dark teal front windshield panes with wipers, ivory pillars, orange bumper and rectangular headlights and grille. Square warm-ivory service-locker shoulders with orange borders; orange/ivory forearms with compact silver hose/nozzle stowed along forearms, normal black fists. Ivory thighs and long orange/ivory shins, wide orange/ivory feet, black soles.
EXACTLY SIX road wheels total retained from the three-axle truck: ONE wheel on each OUTER HIP (2 total), TWO vertically stacked tandem wheels on OUTER SIDE of EACH SHIN (4 total). No shoulder wheel, no elbow wheel, no extra spare wheel. From front only narrow wheel profiles visible at outer edges; do not turn the body to expose them.
Back bridge is TWO matching folded long thick flat bridge-leaf packs, paired behind shoulders down to waist/upper-thigh, with orange caps and ivory long surfaces, hydraulic hinges. They sit behind the body, not as huge overhead roof or wings. Two slim white/teal fire tanks together at ANATOMICAL RIGHT rear waist (viewer LEFT), pump/reel at LEFT rear waist; only naturally visible edges in front. FOUR vehicle stabilizing outriggers folded compactly into waist/back tool housings, NOT robot legs. The robot has exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. No quadruped, no centaur, no extra limbs, no added guns. Preserve same source character, construction language and component colors.
